# Italo.dev

> Portfolio of Italo Saraiva Goncalves, an AI-assisted full-stack developer focused on production-ready web products, SaaS platforms, internal systems, API integrations, and workflow automation.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/): Professional overview, capabilities, and selected work.
- [Projects](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects.html): Portfolio index with project case-study links.
- [CV](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/cv.html): Experience, education, skills, and downloadable resume.
- [Contact](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/contact.html): Professional contact options and social profiles.

## Focus areas

- Laravel, Blade, PHP, JavaScript, SQL, and full-stack product development.
- Bubble.io, FlutterFlow, n8n, API integrations, AI-assisted development, and workflow automation.
- SaaS architecture, document workflows, responsive UI, web scraping, and operational tooling.

## Selected project pages

- [NYC for Free](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/nyc-for-free.html): React Native, Expo, and Supabase mobile product.
- [Bizaclia](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/bizaclia.html): AI agents, web scraping, n8n, and Bubble.io real estate workflows.
- [Beehind the Scene](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/beehind-the-scene.html): Next.js and Supabase talent platform.
- [The Attributes](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/the-attributes.html): Bubble.io assessment platform with AI chatbot and API integrations.
- [Silverdash](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/silverdash.html): Monday.com-connected financial analytics platform.
- [SDI](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/sdi.html): Power Automate, n8n, and Microsoft Teams workflows.
- [Adult Hockey League](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/adult-hockey-league.html): Bubble.io league management and Stripe payment workflows.
- [NamTab](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/namtab.html): AI-powered business process and data management platform.
- [Meni Digital](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/meni-digital.html): Food service customer experience platform.
- [BusQme](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/busqme.html): Service marketplace with booking, availability, payments, and reviews.
- [PetConnect MVP](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/petconnect.html): FlutterFlow and Firebase pet services marketplace.
- [OneStepAfter](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/onestepafter.html): Goal, habit, progress, and community platform.
- [GrantChamps](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/grantchamps.html): Grant management SaaS with document workflows.
- [HiVaulted](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects/hivaulted.html): AI social media content platform with Meta, LinkedIn, Twilio, Cloudinary, Stripe, Outlook, and additional integrations.
